title: Romans Road
description: A path of verses through the book of Romans that walks through why we need Jesus and how to trust him.

waypoints.title: A Path Through Romans
waypoints.body: The book of Romans lays out God's plan of salvation so clearly that people call it the 'Romans Road' -- five verses that walk from the problem (sin) to the solution (Jesus) to the response (trusting him).

waypoints.title: Walk the Road
waypoints.body: Walk through the Romans Road out loud with a parent, one verse at a time. Is there a step you want to talk more about?
